page.overview:
Who is Shion?

Shion is a member of the Kuja. She is never seen but her name appears on the match-ups of the arena battle board.

Little is known about Shion's abilities, but, since her odds of winning were 1:5, it can be presumed that she is stronger than her opponent, Kiku.

Shion's name was seen on the list of match-ups in the arena battles. She was paired against Kiku.
